briefings.message: Reid Detmers is the high-confidence predicted starter. Look for fastballs when your matchup supports it, but stay disciplined against the slider, which has a 35.3% whiff rate and 0.221 xwOBA allowed in his profile. Jordan Walker, Nelson Velázquez, and Jimmy Crooks have fastball opportunities; Crooks’ LHP and pitch-group samples are small, and Velázquez’s LHP, breaking-ball, and offspeed samples are small. If a right-handed reliever enters late with Blaze Jordan due in a run-scoring spot, Bryan Torres is the planned pinch-hit option; his LHP and pitch-group samples are small.
reminders: Look for fastballs when the matchup supports it.
Avoid chasing the changeup below the zone.

briefings.headline: Change speeds and keep their threats off balance
briefings.message: Michael McGreevy starts against the Angels. Vary speeds and work breaking balls off the plate to Mike Trout; avoid predictable fastballs. Keep Nolan Schanuel from settling into fastball counts by changing speeds and keeping the ball down. Use breaking balls below the zone to Zach Neto, and stay out of the heart against Jorge Soler; the matchup sample versus offspeed is small. In close games, Ryne Stanek and George Soriano are the setup arms ahead of Riley O'Brien. Matt Svanson is limited after pitching yesterday.
reminders: Use long relief if the starter exits early.
Preserve leverage arms when the game is not close.
Keep O'Brien for the decisive finish.

briefings.headline: Match up carefully and preserve late leverage
briefings.message: The high-confidence prediction has Reid Detmers starting; hitters should hunt fastballs when the matchup supports it and stay disciplined against his slider. Matt Svanson is limited after pitching yesterday. Jordan Walker, Alec Burleson, and Iván Herrera start despite rest suggestions. Masyn Winn is resting and is the planned late defensive replacement at shortstop. JoJo Romero, Max Rajcic, and Ramón Urías are out.
reminders: Preserve late-inning leverage arms for close games.
Use Winn for a late defensive change at shortstop.
